title: A field-biased quantum master equation and its Markovian limit
summary: We present a non-equilibrium quantum master equation for a driven open quantum system in the presence of a continuously applied electromagnetic field. Starting from a driven Caldeira-Leggett (CL) model in which the external electromagnetic field couples simultaneously to the subsystem and reservoir degrees of freedom, the canonical fluctuation-dissipation theorem (FDT) relations that encode the coefficients of the master equation can no longer be expected to hold.
